{{Quote|&hellip;the Javin's got plenty of places to hide&hellip;|[[Solomahal/Legends|Solomahal]]|<ref name="Javin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref>}}
The '''Greater Javin''' was a relatively backwater region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Formally organized as the Javin [[Sector/Legends|regional sector]], it comprised three subsectors: [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin]], [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat]], and [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith]]. The Greater Javin opened to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] some [[500 BBY/Legends|five hundred years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], thanks to the efforts of entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], whose [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] blazed new, lucrative [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] through the region, which turned the Greater Javin into an economic powerhouse. The [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] ran directly through the region, and its economy was heavily influenced by the interests of the [[Figg family]].

==Description==
[[File:Greater_Javin_sector.jpg|thumb|left|210px|The Greater Javin and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Greater Javin comprised the three [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin]], [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat]], and [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith]]. The Javin sector, with its capital at [[Javin]] on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], comprised the eleven worlds that had been part of [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]] before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] annexed the region. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many former [[Mugaari]] colonies such as [[High Chunah]] and [[Kumru]] had become prosperous, industrialised [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Anoat and Yarith sectors were defined by the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax]] and [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax]]. An ancient [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] created the nebulae (though strictly speaking the Twin Nebulae was in fact a single irregular [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]), as well as [[The Ring/Legends|the Ring]], a [[Black dwarf/Legends|black dwarf]] near [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] in the Anoat sector. The Twin Nebulae complicated navigation through the Greater Javin for centuries until Ecclessis Figg blazed new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] through the region.<ref name="TEA" />

The Anoat sector had its capital at Gerrenthum, the crossroads of the Corellian Trade Spine, the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]], and the [[Nothoiin Corridor]], making it a megaworld that was the headquarters of the [[Figg conglomerate]]. The Anoat sector also comprised the industrialised [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining Worlds]] of [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]], [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]], and (after the Galactic Civil War) [[Isis/Legends|Isis]], which could be reached from [[Ione/Legends|Ione]] on the Trade Spine. The [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] was a bypass of the Corellian Trade Spine that ran through the sector, and linked the Spine to the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] mining colony of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] containing the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] homeworld of [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]] and [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]] itself, and the ice world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The Yarith sector had its capital at [[Isde Naha/Legends|Isde Naha]], another heavily-industrialised tradeworld that was at the crossroads of the Trade Spine and the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]] and hosted numerous Figg interests. [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] was another influential world at the hub of the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]].<ref name="TEA" />

Because the Greater Javin had been opened up to the [[galactic community]] largely by the efforts of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Lord Ecclessis Figg]], the [[Figg family]] held considerable economic power in the region through businesses like the [[Outer Javin Company]], [[Figg & Associates]], and [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]]. Hoping to check ambitions in the Greater Javin, the Galactic Republic deliberately drew a zigzagging border between the Anoat and Yarith sectors to cut off neighboring worlds politically and blunt local power.<ref name="TEA" /> However, largely thanks to the efforts of Lord Figg himself, the native [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]], [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiins]], and (to a lesser extent) [[Mugaari]] all held considerably economic power as well.<ref name="Javin" />

==History==
===The New Sith Wars===
[[File:Rohlan_of_Kaal_by_John_Van_Fleet.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Rohlan of Kaal]] battles Sith pirates on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].]]
Around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the planet [[Javin]] on the edge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] marked the dividing line between the civilised galaxy and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] Rimward of [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]] was lightly settled, and beyond Javin were the [[Mugaari]], [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]], and [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] civilisations that could only be accessed by slow routes that had to detour around the dangerous [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]]. The Mugaari maintained a [[Mugaari Space/Legends|small empire]] in the region that had influence as far Rimward as [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]], where they subjected the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[New Sith Wars]], the region fell under the control of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-affiliated [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] based at [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]] raided up the Corellian Trade Spine. The pirates were defeated by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Rohlan]] of [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]] in a [[Battle of Hoth (New Sith Wars)|battle]] at [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], who earned the title of [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]] for his victory. Lord Hoth went on to defeat the Brotherhood of Darkness at the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===Lord Figg's expeditions===
[[File:EcclessisFiggStatue-JoY.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], who opened up the Greater Javin to the wider galaxy.]]
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forcibly annexed the eleven worlds of [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]] after a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|brief war]] roughly one thousand years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], establishing the sprawling [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin subsector]]. However, it was not until around [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]] that [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ships]] owned by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] began finding safe routes through the region.<ref name="TEA" /> A [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who had married into [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] nobility, Figg discovered [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]], a valuable [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] coolant and [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]], in the atmosphere of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Using [[Yarith Figg|his wife's]] family's money to make the initial investment, Figg established the first [[Cloud City/Legends|mining colony]] on Bespin with the help of the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] of nearby [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]].<ref name="Javin" />

Operating from [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]], Figg also established the [[Outer Javin Company]], which found routes through the Twin Nebulae. This spurred a trade boom in the Greater Javin that made Figg extremely rich.<ref name="Javin" /><ref name="TEA" /> To avoid inter-species conflict that might interfere with his business operations, as well as to avoid scrutiny from the Republic, Figg also ensured that the native Lutrillians and Nothoiins benefited from the increased wealth.<ref name="Javin" />

In the last year of his life, Figg presided over a ceremony that inaugurated a new subsector in the booming region. Figg had pressed for the name "Ecclessis", after himself, but the Republic named the new subsector the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] after an ancient surveying note.<ref name="TEA" />

===The fall of the Republic===
Generations after Figg's death, the Republic partitioned the Anoat sector in an effort to check ambitions in the region. The new border was deliberately zigzagging in order to cut off neighboring worlds and blunt their power. Though they failed to prevent the move, the [[Figg family]] did see the new sector named the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]], after Ecclessis Figg's wife.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Greater Javin was part of the [[Javin Oversector]], the area of operations of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Nineteenth Army]].<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]] was [[Battle of Gentes|invaded]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during the Clone Wars, destroying much of the planet's infrastructure and seeing many [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] taken off into slavery.<ref name="General Grievous">''[[Star Wars: General Grievous]]''</ref>

===The Galactic Civil War===
[[File:Isis.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Isis/Legends|Isis]], a Rebel Alliance safe world in the Greater Javin during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].]]
Government control was historically light in a region so far from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] largely left the Greater Javin to its own devices. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] secretly maintained the planet [[Isis/Legends|Isis]] as a [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]], but was forced to abandon it just after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Isis">''[[The Isis Coordinates]]''</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] rediscovered the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the Anoat sector while returning from a [[Battle at the Iron Tower|mission]] on [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]]. Luke recommended the isolated planet to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] as the potential site for a new base of operations, and in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]] established [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on Hoth.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet seemed like a superb find for the Alliance: Hoth was situated on the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]], a decaying hyperspace bypass of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] whose only common destination was [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The difficulties of traversing the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] and the debris field of the [[Ison system/Legends|Ison system]] Rimward meant that ships invariably reached Bespin from the Coreward end of the Corridor from [[Indellian]]. Very few ships passed beyond Bespin to [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]], Hoth, or [[Ison/Legends|Ison]] itself. Hoth was therefore secluded, largely unknown, but gave the Alliance quick access to the Corellian Trade Spine for raiding.<ref name="TEA" /> Nevertheless, the base commander, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], demanded a permanent state of readiness to evacuate should Echo Base be discovered.<ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:Snowspeeders-ST.jpg|thumb|left|240px|[[Snowspeeder/Legends|Rebel snowspeeders]] approaching Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]]]
Echo Base was ultimately discovered in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lord Darth Vader]]. Rebel supplies captured in a [[Battle of Derra IV|convoy ambush]] at [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]] allowed the Empire to narrow its search to the Western Reaches, and thousands of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] were dispatched throughout the region.<ref name="Warfare" /> Two of Death Squadron's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', were detached to the [[Ione system/Legends|Ione system]], where they deployed [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] to the [[Allyuen system/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Tokmia system/Legends|Tokmia]], and [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth systems]]. The probe deployed to Hoth located Echo Base shortly afterwards and relayed the information to Death Squadron, based in the [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] commenced shortly afterwards, a violent defeat that nearly crippled the Rebellion, with only thirteen of thirty escaping Rebel [[Transport/Legends|transports]] surviving the blockade. Pursued by Death Squadron, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] fled through the Hoth system's [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] via the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was forced to surrender the Rebels to Darth Vader, but he helped them escape after the Empire reneged on its deal and [[Occupation of Bespin|occupied Bespin]].<ref name="EpV">{{Film|V}}</ref>

Bespin was the site of several [[Raid on Bespin|raids]] and [[Battle of Bespin (Galactic Civil War)|battles]] over the next year before the Galactic Empire's defeat at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. In the aftermath of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death, the Anoat sector was one of the first regions to throw off the Empire and declare for the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> One month after Endor, [[Lando's Commandos]], led by Calrissian, now a New Republic General, [[Liberation of Bespin|liberated Bespin]] from Imperial rule. The [[New Republic First Fleet]] then advanced through the Greater Javin from [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] to engage [[Warlord/Legends|Warlords]] [[Utoxx Prentioch|Prentioch]] and [[Sander Delvardus|Delvardus]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
===Lutrillians===
Native to the cold, [[Water/Legends|waterless]] world of [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]] in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]], the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] were short, somewhat [[Porcine/Legends|porcine]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] readily adapted to cold conditions.<ref name="GEO">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> On their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], they lived a [[nomad]]ic lifestyle that had developed from migrating between the planet's [[Oasis|oases]]. They had adapted this to modern technology with the development of wheeled [[City/Legends|platform-cities]]: more than a hundred such cities rolled across the planet's equatorial zone, attended by vehicles carrying travellers and freight.<ref name="TEA" />

The Lutrillians were considered natural entrepreneurs, and the Figg routes, in particular the [[Lutrillian Cross/Legends|Lutrillian Cross]], made the species rich. Lutrillian merchant colonies were established throughout the region, including on [[Kirtarkin/Legends|Kirtarkin]], [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]], and [[Ione/Legends|Ione]].<ref name="Javin" /> The Lutrillians were considered an economic power in the region and generally maintained good relations with the Nothoiins and immigrated [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Mugaari===
The heavy-browed, lantern-jawed [[Mugaari]] had ruled a small empire of eleven worlds from their homeworld [[Mugaar/Legends|Mugaar]] centuries before Figg's expeditions. The Galactic Republic had [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|forcibly annexed]] [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]], leading many Mugaari to resent Humans as invaders and occupiers. The Mugaari also tended to look down on the Lutrillians and Nothoiin as collaborators.<ref name="TEA" />

The Mugaari held somewhat less economic power in the Greater Javin than the Nothoiins and Lutrillians.<ref name="TEA" /> A resistance group known as the [[Mugaari pirates]] allied with the Rebel Alliance against the Galactic Empire during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>

===Nothoiins===
The [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiins]] were golden-skinned humanoids with high craniums native to [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]]. They had traded valuable [[Ur-diamond/Legends|ur-diamonds]] with the Republic for centuries before Ecclessis Figg opened up the region's hyperspace routes, and the Nothoiins benefited from the increased trade.<ref name="Javin" /> Their homeworld was a grassy planet known for the giant wildfires that had raged across its rolling plains since before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and consequently the planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] were surrounded by kilometers-wide burn rings for protection.<ref name="TEA" />

Their planet's ash-choked atmosphere caused many Nothoiins to seek their fortune offworld, and Nothoiin colonies could be found on [[Bavva/Legends|Bavva]], [[Kirtarkin/Legends|Kirtarkin]], Gerrenthum, Ione and [[Polmanar/Legends|Polmanar]].<ref name="GEO" /> [[Council (planet)/Legends|Council]] was the seat of the Nothoiin government, and served as a meeting place for colony representatives.<ref name="TEA" />

===Ugnaughts===
The [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] were a hardy, porcine species native to [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]]. The Ugnaughts were favored as workers, and had been enslaved by the Mugaari for centuries before the Republic annexed the region.<ref name="TEA" /> Republic control gave the Ugnaughts a measure of protection, and the species was recruited by Lord Figg to assist in the construction of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="Javin" />

Gentes and its moon [[Belsus/Legends|Belsus]] began to thrive as industrial worlds, but both were devastated by the [[Battle of Gentes|Separatist invasion]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="General Grievous" /> Many Ugnaughts abandoned the planet soon afterwards, though by the close of the Galactic Civil War, they formally controlled Bespin's Cloud City.<ref name="TEA" />
